outputs.headline: SCAM: No free laptops from the government for students
outputs.summary: The claim that the Indian government is providing free laptops to all students under a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is a scam.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that the Indian government is providing free laptops to all students under a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'.
outputs.what_is_true: The Indian government has not announced any 'PM Free Laptop Scheme'. Messages promoting such a scheme are scams designed to steal personal information.
evidence_against: Vishvas News rated the claim as false, stating the scheme is fake.
The Quint rated the claim as false, stating PM Modi did not announce such a scheme.
DigitEye India rated the claim as totally false, stating no such scheme has been launched.
The Press Information Bureau (PIB) Fact Check has repeatedly debunked such claims, stating these are scams to collect personal information.
outputs.sources_spoken: Vishvas News, The Quint, DigitEye India, and the Press Information Bureau
outputs.audio_script: The post claims that the Indian government is providing free laptops to all students under a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026'. This is a scam. The Indian government has not announced any such scheme. Messages promoting this are scams designed to steal personal information. We are very sure about this. This information comes from fact-checking organizations like Vishvas News, The Quint, DigitEye India, and the Press Information Bureau.
card_lines: Post claims government gives free laptops
This is a scam to steal data

outputs.headline: Scam: PM Free Laptop Scheme link is fake
outputs.summary: The website link for the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme' is fake and part of a phishing scam.
outputs.what_post_claims: The post claims that to register for the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026', one must click on the link www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in and enter their name.
outputs.what_is_true: The website link provided for the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme' is fake and part of a phishing scam. Official Indian government websites typically use the ".gov.in" domain.
evidence_against: India Today reported that the claim to click on the link www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in for a 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is false and a scam.
Geo.tv stated that the link is fake and part of a scam, noting that official Indian government websites end with ".gov.in".
Alt News explained that fraudulent websites use attractive offers like free laptops to trick people into sharing personal details for phishing.
outputs.sources_spoken: India Today, Geo.tv, and Alt News
outputs.audio_script: A post claims that to register for the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme 2026', you need to click on a specific link and enter your name. This is a scam. The website link provided for the 'PM Free Laptop Scheme' is fake and part of a phishing scam. Official Indian government websites typically use the ".gov.in" domain. We are very sure about this. This information comes from reports by India Today, Geo.tv, and Alt News.
